one_line: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid a personal relationship scandal, prompting leadership transitions and policy inquiries.

themes.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
themes.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned after admitting to a personal relationship, with CFO Colette Kress taking over as interim CEO. The departure triggered market concerns, investor succession letters, supply chain warnings, and a congressional inquiry into export controls and chip sales.
